name: The High Priestess Counts the Steps

body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two detected enemies within 6 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, learn each target's lowest Defense and remaining Reaction Dice, and reveal its occupied space through ordinary concealment until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: One hit target suffers -1 Harmony against the next attack targeting it until the start of your next turn.
One willing ally within 3 units gains +1 Defense against each hit target's next attack until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Divination
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: bind one hit target. Trigger: it declares an Action with 3 or more rolled dice. Echo: yourself or a willing ally within 3 units may move 2 units before its roll.
